lookupBridges.component: Package\Foreach Loop Container\Minhali daily\Get Aggregate Fund Balance
lookupBridges.note: Written earlier in the same loop by 'Aggregate Account Balance\Fill table AggregateFunds' (INSERT, same connection manager SQL.GENERIX_STAGING, DTSX 664) after 'Truncate table AggregateFunds' (DTSX 93619); precedence Create Kibutz -> Truncate table AggregateFunds -> Aggregate Account Balance -> Minhali daily (DTSX 98834-98836). Writer values: Aggregate (DTSX 541-604) GROUP BY gen_bankname (product lookup), gen_bankaccountnumber (raw staging Bank_Account_Number_27, NOT trimmed/padded), gen_producttypeid (product lookup on raw Course_Number_22), SUM(gen_accountbalance) where gen_accountbalance = (DT_CY) Employee_Portion_Total_65 + Employer_Portion_Total_66 + Compensation_Portion_Total_67 after Format money fields (/100) (DTSX 2516). Reader (full cache, IgnoreFailure) joins on gen_bankaccountnumber (Minhali: Trim + PadLeft(12,'0')), gen_bankname, gen_producttypeid and returns gen_accountbalance as gen_aggregateaccountbalance, which is NOT written to CRM directly: it is a lookup parameter of 'Get fund MF template data' (partial cache, SqlCommandParam: gen_maxamount >= aggregate balance for the fund's Mf_Template_Id_164) whose Gen_mfpercentage becomes gen_managementfeepercentage (Set MF) and whose numofrecords drives gen_mfratedtotal -> both written by Create gen_FundMain (and gen_managementfeepercentage by Update gen_fundmain). So the file money fields #65/#66/#67 aggregated per account+product influence (key role) the CRM management-fee % of every fund of that account. No other component in the package reads AggregateFunds (grep DTSX: only lines 664, 69952-69953, 93619).
